headline: Goolets - Luxury Yacht Charter Experts
primaryText: Croatia and Turkey specialists with offices in 5 countries. Full concierge included. Private crewed yacht charters. 30,000+ guests served. MYBA member. Get a proposal. 20+ Years Experience.
whyItWorks: It stacks credibility signals such as guest count, years in business, an industry membership and a multi-country footprint, so a high-ticket buyer feels safe before clicking. The sitelinks split intent by destination and by audience (Greece, Croatia, families), letting searchers jump straight to what matches them. The low-pressure proposal request fits a considered purchase.
